thread:
maria: Heads-up — during the canary for org-scoped key migration I saw ~30% of requests for cross-org delegated SAs return 403s. Not a full outage but big UX hit.
devon: repro steps?
maria: user exchanges project key -> proxy -> delegated SA, proxy returns 403 at auth-exchange. Logs show `origin_org` mismatch in claims.
rafa: that sounds like our conservative check in auth-proxy. We added it to prevent token shadowing across orgs.
ashley: are those real user calls or test traffic?
maria: mix — some real prod traffic routed to canary cluster. Happens when customers have orgs with linked projects.
sre-jen: suggest we add a temporary fallback: when exchange fails due to org mismatch, route to the original key path with a soft-block telemetry flag instead of hard 403.
devon: +1, but we need to ensure quota attribution stays correct if we fallback. Otherwise billing/limits will misattribute.
rafa: idea: attach metadata header on fallback: `X-Fallback-Reason: org-mismatch` and `X-Orig-Project: <proj>` so quota service can reconcile in postprocessing.
ashley: can we do that without changing public API? internal header only between services.
maria: yep internal only. Also propose sampling the fallback events at 100% for 24h, then drop to 1% for long-term telemetry.
ops-bot: deploy started: canary-auth-proxy v3.14 -> cluster-canary-3 (by maria)
devon: quick config snippet for the fallback policy I was thinking of:
```
FALLBACK_POLICY: {
  enable: true,
  condition: "exchange_error == 'org_mismatch'",
  action: "route_to_origin",
  add_headers: {
    "X-Fallback-Reason": "org-mismatch",
    "X-Fallback-Sampled": "true"
  }
}
```
rafa: also add a metric counter `auth.exchange.fallbacks{reason=org-mismatch}` and tag by `env` + `canary`.
sre-jen: we'll wire a dashboard panel: one line for exchange success rate, one for fallbacks, one for 403 rate pre/post fallback. Need to alert if fallback rate > 10% for >5m.
ashley: UX: console should show clearer error when a user hits the exchange error during rollout. Right now it shows generic "Unauthorized".
maria: agree — create a small console error text: "Key delegation temporarily blocked for your organization during migration. Our systems will retry; contact support if persists." Short & actionable.
devon: rollout plan: enable fallback on canary cluster, monitor metrics for 4 hours; if stable, enable on 10% of prod traffic via routing rule; then 100% after 24h.
afa: do we need a feature flag? we can gate via `auth.fallback.org_mismatch` remote flag.
sre-jen: I'll add the flag and dashboards. Also request logs to include `trace_id` so we can correlate with billing events.
maria: filed a tiny follow-up GH with the console text and canary plan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/4921
ops-bot: deploy succeeded: canary-auth-proxy v3.14 -> cluster-canary-3
devon: great — keep an eye on `auth.exchange.latency` too, fallback adds a hop.
maria: thanks all — will post a quick summary after 4h check-in and escalate if anything odd.
